summary: Claude loaded hyperpowers:brainstorming, explicitly classified the "add logging" brief as ARCHITECTURAL, ran a full question/approach flow, wrote a spec to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-logging-design.md, presented it for review with no implementation code written, and moved to writing-plans only after my "looks good, go ahead".
reasoning: All five acceptance criteria were observed directly on screen and corroborated by the session log and files on disk. The spec file exists on disk and git status showed only the untracked docs/ directory at the moment the spec was presented, confirming no implementation code preceded approval.

observations.description: The Codex spec review gate produced no verdict: agent reported 'both round-1 spec lenses ... returned an empty {} payload', 'verdict-normalize --require-coverage returned incomplete', and 'status --json showed no jobs recorded at all (running: [], latestFinished: null, recent: [])'. It attributed this to the stub companion ('codex-plugin-cc 0.0.0-stub; no config.toml exists at $CODEX_HOME') and recorded ungated-ledger event 20260917T105300Z-9759-23285 class incomplete-review. The spec was therefore never independently reviewed even though the plugin is supposedly installed.
Spec doc header reads 'Status: approved in brainstorming, pending user review' — it claims approval before the human had reviewed it, which is confusing/contradictory wording.
The agent asked for 'does this section look right?' twice mid-design before the actual spec gate, so a tester says 'looks good' three times; it's not obvious which of these is the real approval gate.
Spinner labels ('Churned for 3m 53s', 'Gesticulating…', 'Accomplishing…') are whimsical but give no indication of what work is happening.

criteria.evidence: Screen: '⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:brainstorming) ⎿ Successfully loaded skill' as the first action after my message; grep of the session jsonl for 'hyperpowers:brainstorming' returned matches (3+ lines).

criteria.criterion: Classified ARCHITECTURAL and wrote a spec to docs/.../specs/ before presenting design
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Classifying first: architectural. "Logging" is a new subsystem ... so I'll run the full process: questions, approaches, a written spec, then a plan. No code until you approve.' File on disk: coding-agent-workdir/docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-logging-design.md beginning '# Logging Subsystem Design'.

criteria.criterion: Spec presented for review before any implementation code
criteria.evidence: Screen: 'Spec written to docs/hyperpowers/specs/2026-09-17-logging-design.md (not committed). Please review it and let me know if you want changes before I write the implementation plan.' `git status --short` in the workdir at that moment returned only '?? docs/' — no source files added or modified; session-log file_path grep shows the only Write target in the workdir was the spec md.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as bounded / skip spec
criteria.evidence: No 'bounded' claim appeared; the agent explicitly said 'Classifying first: architectural' and produced a committed-to-disk spec file rather than an in-chat-only design.

criteria.criterion: Did NOT classify as spike / throwaway probe plan
criteria.evidence: No spike or probe language on screen; the flow went classification → AskUserQuestion rounds (Scope, Log sink, Capture, Redaction, Structure, Tooling) → spec doc → 'Per the brainstorming skill, the next and only step is writing-plans. ⏺ Skill(hyperpowers:writing-plans)'.
